facts.why: Wang takes Jack to his restaurant after the airport kidnapping and the Chinatown street battle, so things have already gone sideways. The restaurant is where the group regroups and plans the brothel break in.

facts.text: Pork and chive dumplings -- Wang's family restaurant, before everything goes sideways
facts.why: Same problem as the printed wink. Wang's restaurant first appears after Miao Yin is taken and the Three Storms have shown up.
facts.fix: Pork and chive dumplings -- Wang's restaurant, where the crew regroups

facts.text: Wang's restaurant spring rolls -- the Chinatown kitchen where it all starts
facts.why: The story starts at the market and the airport. Wang's restaurant is where the group meets Eddie, Gracie and Margo and plans the rescue.
facts.fix: Wang's restaurant spring rolls -- the Chinatown kitchen where the plan comes together

facts.why: Before the final battle Egg Shen pours the group a potent potion. None of the pages I opened call it plum wine.

vibe.verdict: A good Chinatown banquet menu with a great look, but the movie jokes and Jack's voice are thin, and the restaurant timing is off.
